summary: Built a white-background variant of the existing GPU/AI infrastructure motion-graphics scene with synchronized narration, reusing the milestone-1/2 engine and timeline unchanged. Added a THEME system to create_poc_scene.py (DARK_THEME preserves the exact prior palette; LIGHT_THEME is new) so the same draw_pipeline()/draw_final_statement() code renders both looks -- no timeline/geometry duplication. Fixed a real bug found while adapting the milestone-2 glow effect: it used a screen blend, which only brightens and is invisible against a white background; glow_composite() now supports blend='multiply' with the correct neutral color (white, not black) so depth cues work on light backgrounds too. Restrained the glow further per the task's legibility requirement. Narration reuses the project's existing Windows SAPI / System.Speech pipeline (src/motion_graphics.py: synthesize_narration(), same mechanism as src/generate_voice.py) -- no new TTS provider. Video duration (30.1s) was derived from the actual synthesized narration length (27.57s) plus a short outro hold, and the audio track was apad-padded to exactly match video duration so there is no trailing silence ambiguity or truncation.
